hpi: West Nile Virus is a neurotropic virus that can cause viral meningitis and encephalitis. The most common symptoms are fever, headache, and altered mental status. Most patients will have a mild illness, but some will develop severe neurological disease. The diagnosis is made clinically, and supportive care is the mainstay of treatment.
